speed_basis: economical speed for the base case; students may test warranted speed
laycan_wait_formula: maximum of zero and laycan start minus arrival at load
loading_days_formula: selected lift / load rate + load turn time / 24
discharge_days_formula: selected lift / discharge rate + discharge turn time / 24
voyage_days_formula: ballast + laycan wait + loading + laden + discharge
fuel_scope: VLSFO and MGO at sea; VLSFO in port; opening ROB is used for purchase planning
bunker_cost_formula: fuel consumed multiplied by the monthly price at the bunker pricing location stated in ports.csv
bunker_purchase_formula: maximum of zero and consumption plus reserve minus opening ROB
departure_deadweight_formula: selected lift + laden-leg fuel + reserves + other deadweight
draft_formula: ballast draft + (summer draft - ballast draft) * departure deadweight / DWT
tce_formula: (freight revenue - commission - bunker cost - port cost - canal cost) / voyage days
voyage_contribution_formula: freight revenue - commission - bunker cost - port cost - canal cost - hire rate * voyage days
